description: This Java class 'SSLUtil' provides utility methods for setting up SSL connections, managing trust and key managers, SSL contexts, socket factories, and hostname verification, specifically for handling SSL/TLS configurations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: TrustAnyManager
classes.description: A TrustManager implementation that trusts all certificates without validation, used for bypassing SSL certificate validation.

classes.name: SSLUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for SSL context setup, trust and key manager management, socket factory creation, hostname verification, and configuration loading.

methods.name: getHostCertNoCheck
methods.description: Returns constant indicating no certificate check.

methods.name: getHostCertMinCheck
methods.description: Returns constant indicating minimum certificate check.

methods.name: getHostCertNormalCheck
methods.description: Returns constant indicating normal certificate check.

methods.name: isClientTrusted
methods.description: Checks if a client certificate chain is trusted based on current trust managers.

methods.name: getKeyManagers
methods.description: Retrieves KeyManager array for a given keystore and alias.

methods.name: getTrustManagers
methods.description: Retrieves TrustManager array for all configured keystores.

methods.name: getTrustAnyManagers
methods.description: Returns TrustManager array that trusts all certificates.

methods.name: getSSLSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates SSLSocketFactory using specified keystore, password, and alias.

methods.name: getSSLContext
methods.description: Creates SSLContext with specified keystore, trust settings, and alias.

methods.name: getSSLServerSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates SSLServerSocketFactory with specified keystore and alias.

methods.name: getHostnameVerifier
methods.description: Provides hostname verifier based on specified level of certificate checking.

methods.name: loadJsseProperties
methods.description: Loads JSSE properties from configuration for SSL setup.
